text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
What an incredible roar from the crowd... Hearing it from the perspective
of a runner feels completely different.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone's expectations, their dreams...
I see... so this is the Derby."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Just a little, yeah.
Still, I'm savoring every moment, nerves and all."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I'm really... standing on the stage of the Derby...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I may have ended up in the outermost gate, but that doesn't bother me at all.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
In this race known as the grandest in Japan,
I'll show everyone an overwhelming run!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: What?! Make sure to root for me, okay!
